name: onboarding-stepper-flow
title: Onboarding Stepper Flow
description: A multi-step onboarding scene: a stepper advances across three panels (an input, a radio, a switch) while the Next button presses, and the last press runs the Finish button to success.
useWhen: Demoing a multi-step onboarding experience (account setup, plan choice, preferences) in one scene.
Showing progressive form completion with a stepper indicator advancing across panels.
A product video needs a complete new-user flow from first input to success without custom orchestration.
avoidWhen: The flow is a payment checkout: use checkout-flow.
It is a single account sign-up (email and password, then success): use signup-flow.
You need custom panel content like images or code blocks: the panels are fixed, so orchestrate manually.
author: Remocn

variables.label: Name
variables.description: Text typed into the first panel's input.

variables.label: Plans
variables.description: JSON array of plan names; the second one is picked in the second panel.

variables.label: Next label
variables.description: Label of the button on the first panels.

variables.label: Finish label
variables.description: Label of the button on the last panel.

variables.label: Speed
variables.description: Playback speed of the scripted interaction. 2 plays it twice as fast and holds the end.

variables.label: Transparent
variables.description: Leave the background clear so the control sits over your own scene.
